title: Tomb of Prophet Ayyub (a)
introduction:
TOMB OF PROPHET AYYUB (A)

Ayoub, a son of Amoz, bin Razach – ben Rizm - Ben n Ais Prophet Ishaq (peace be upon him) son of the Prophet Ibraham (peace be upon him). Known today the shrine of the Prophet Ayyub (peace be upon him) and it is just four leagues from Babylon in the western side of the Euphrates from east of Hilla, near Kifil , and on the right of the entrance of the tomb there is a well that visitors intended to wash from its water to recover by God willing and with the blessing of ratios to Ayyub (peace be upon him)

This Rauza is very famous for couples who come to make a Nadr (wish) that they be blessed with a child. It is in Balad a small village near samarrah.
